title: DISTURBING FEARS - Workplace
description:
DISTURBING FEARS is an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.

Each episode captures the terrifying intensity of real stories, reminding you that this could have happened to you.

This is the first installment of the DISTURBING FEARS anthology.

DISTURBING FEARS : WorkplaceTo make some extra money, Emma agrees to work late at the office. Once everyone else heads home, the building grows eerily quiet—so quiet it starts to feel unsettling. Emma has no idea what awaits her during one of those night shifts.

The GameplayA first-person walking simulator focused on realism. Encounter disturbing situations and face your fears. Inspired by the atmosphere and storytelling of Fears to Fathom and Chilla's Art.

Key Features• Photorealistic Graphics and Atmospheric Environments — Feel the fear in environments true-to-life visuals as if you were there.

• VHS Aesthetic — Visuals effects inspired by classic horror films of the ’90s.

• Player Voice Activity — Interaction system with your microphone (a microphone isn’t required to play, but it’s recommended for the best experience).

• Real-Life Movement Tracking — Interaction system with your webcam (a webcam isn’t required to play, but it’s recommended for the best experience).

• Interact with NPCs — Receive texts from NPCs and experience deeper story immersion.
description_short: DISTURBING FEARS is an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.
